Gritt is an intelligent system that combines robotics and AI to build the infrastructure that pulls society forward. Watch Video We need more infrastructure than the construction workforce can deliver. Trillions of dollars in global infrastructure spending is planned. 41% of the U.S. construction workforce will retire by 2031. The gap is everywhere, on jobsites and in back offices. Humans alone can’t fill it. AI-enabled construction ready for the real world. Gritt is on-site building infrastructure with top ten US EPCs today. We’re just getting started. An intelligent system. Not just hardware. Not just AI. Gritt spans intelligence and robotics, all built with one of the world’s largest troves of spatial and operational data. Starts with the hardest jobs. Extends across the full process. Gritt handles pick-and-place, transport, and assembly across solar, concrete, and rebar. We’re expanding to cover verification and planning. See our work in solar Gritt works anywhere work happens. Add Gritt to common equipment using off-the-shelf attachments and minimal custom hardware. Ready for dust, heat, cold, and any terrain. One AI backbone for all construction work. Construction work is five jobs in one. Gritt helps with all of them using the same intelligence. Starting in solar. Expanding to data center and large infrastructure. Physical AI Pick and place Positioning the right parts in the right place Physical AI Assembly Joining parts into finished structures. Physical AI Transportation Moving materials where they need to be, when they need to be there. Spatial AI Verification Inspections, logs, and documentation. The audit trail every project needs. Spatial AI Planning Monitoring sites and recommending next steps Gritt builds infrastructure faster. TBs daily data captured by Gritt machines 7+ deployed jobsites, with more coming 4X efficiency gain, with no added labor Join the team building infrastructure for the next century.
